#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long dfs(const vector<long long>& ones, long long n, int idx) {
    if (idx == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long quot = n / ones[idx];
    long long rem = n % ones[idx];
    long long used = quot * idx;
    if (rem == 0) return used;
    long long option1 = dfs(ones, rem, idx - 1);
    long long option2 = idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - rem, idx - 1);
    return used + min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    vector<long long> ones(17);
    ones[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
        ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    long long ans = dfs(ones, n, 16);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
